messages:
maya.g: heads-up — customer reported audit export CSV dropping service principal info and some fields truncated when exporting >10k rows :eyes:

samir.k: repro steps? browser/export or API? any error logs?

maya.g: API. steps:
1) search for events with actor.type=service_principal (we used query `actor:service_principal`)
2) click Export -> CSV (or call /api/v1/audit/export?format=csv)
3) file missing `actor.type` column for many rows, `resource.kms_key_id` is empty even though DB shows value

sample CSV row we got (redacted):
`2026-02-17T21:10:14Z,CreateKey,alice@acct, ,us-west1,CreateKey,resource:kms/12345,OK`
^^ see empty actor.type column after email field

oliver: that sounds like a schema + serialization mismatch. UI export picks a fixed column set; service principals were added later as `actor.type` (enum) and exporter only uses `actor.identifier` fallback. we also had a defensive truncate at 256 chars for some fields which can cut off kms key ids if combined with long resource names.

irene_p: agreed. we added `actor.type` in the audit schema v2 (2025-08) but exporter codepath still assumes v1. must preserve backwards compat. can we add a versioned export header and keep both `actor` and `actor.type` columns?

compliance-bot: Reminder: export must include `resource.kms_key_id` and `actor.type` for customer audits. Please provide ETA and mitigation.

samir.k: quick repro with curl (permission denied output included):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/audit/export?format=csv&query=actor:service_principal" -o out.csv
# HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
# {"error":"missing_permission: audit.export"}
```

oliver: ah, RBAC nuance — service accounts (non-human) in some orgs only have `audit_viewer` role. that role grants `audit.read` but not `audit.export`. UI export tries to call same API which fails silently and shows partial results after client-side fallback. we should either: grant `audit.export` to `audit_viewer` or show a clear permission error in the UI.

maya.g: customer-facing ask: they need full JSON export (line-delimited JSON) and CSV for legal review. also need pagination cursor so they can resume long exports. current export times out after 30s for large ranges.

oliver: backend supports streaming JSON with `?stream=true&cursor=...` but the UI only uses pagination for the viewer table not exports. we should wire the streaming endpoint to export button and include `next_cursor` in response metadata.

irene_p: schema changes: propose audit schema v3 with fields: `actor.type`, `actor.subtype` (for external SPs), `resource.kms_key_id`, `event.request_bytes_truncated` (flag), and `export_schema_version`. Add auto-backfill for `resource.kms_key_id` where available. Keep v2 compatibility by emitting legacy columns when `export_schema_version=1` requested.

samir.k: notes on KMS: some keys are customer-managed in KMS and we currently only log `resource.kms_key_name` for hosted keys. need to add `resource.kms_key_id` (UUID) and `resource.kms_provider` to satisfy audits. also ensure we never log full plaintext key material (obv).

deploy-bot: deploy checklist created: `ENG-SEC-#4321`:
- add export permission mapping for `audit_viewer` (audit.export) [oliver]
- update exporter to be schema-aware + include actor.type + kms_key_id [samir.k]
- wire streaming endpoint to CSV/JSON export with `next_cursor` [oliver]
- UI: show explicit permission error when export fails + better UX copy [maya.g]
- compliance: verify sample exported files for 3 customers and sign-off [irene_p]

maya.g: can someone pick up the RBAC change this week? customer blocked.

oliver: I can do the RBAC change and UI error copy. will open PR today and ping infra for rollout gating.

samir.k: I'll own schema/exporter work. will add feature flag and migration plan. estimate 3 sprints to fully backfill large orgs (can do opt-in backfill for early customers).

irene_p: I'll coordinate compliance validation and pick three customers for sample export.

maya.g: thanks all. tagging @compliance-bot for audit log checklist. when PRs land pls include sample export artifact in PR. :thumbsup:

compliance-bot: Acknowledged. Added ticket COMP-786 to validate exported fields and retention metadata.
